comment: Turns the USPS shipping method on or off at checkout.
modal: Controls whether USPS shipping rates are offered to customers during checkout. Can be set per website.

comment: Which USPS API integration to use — the legacy XML Web Tools or the newer REST API.
modal: Selects the USPS API the carrier connects through: the legacy **USPS Web Tools (XML)** or the newer **USPS REST** API. The choice determines which credential and gateway fields below apply. Can be set per website.

comment: The USPS Web Tools (XML) endpoint URL rate requests are sent to.
modal: The base URL of the USPS Web Tools (XML) gateway used for rate requests. Applies only when **USPS Type** is the XML Web Tools. Change only if USPS provides a different endpoint. Can be set per website.

comment: The USPS REST API production endpoint URL used for live rate requests.
modal: The USPS REST API endpoint used for rate requests in production. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST and **Mode** is set to live/production. Can be set per website.

comment: The USPS REST API test endpoint URL used when not in production mode.
modal: The USPS REST API endpoint used for rate requests in development/test mode. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST and **Mode** is set to development. Can be set per website.

comment: The secure (HTTPS) USPS Web Tools endpoint used for requests that require it.
modal: The secure USPS Web Tools (XML) gateway URL, used for requests that require HTTPS. Applies only when **USPS Type** is the XML Web Tools. Can be set per website.

comment: The carrier name shown to customers next to USPS shipping options at checkout.
modal: The label displayed to shoppers for this carrier's shipping methods at checkout. Can differ per store view, so each storefront can show its own wording.

comment: The USPS Web Tools (XML) account user ID used to authenticate rate requests.
modal: The user ID issued by USPS for the Web Tools (XML) API, used to authenticate requests. Stored encrypted. Applies only when **USPS Type** is the XML Web Tools.

comment: The password for the USPS Web Tools (XML) account.
modal: The password paired with the USPS Web Tools (XML) user ID. Stored encrypted. Applies only when **USPS Type** is the XML Web Tools.

comment: The consumer key (client ID) for the USPS REST API account.
modal: The OAuth consumer key issued by USPS for the REST API, used to obtain access tokens. Stored encrypted. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST.

comment: The consumer secret (client secret) for the USPS REST API account.
modal: The OAuth consumer secret paired with the USPS REST consumer key. Stored encrypted; keep it confidential. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST.

comment: The kind of USPS account used for REST pricing.
modal: Selects the type of USPS account used with the REST API, which affects the pricing available. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST.

comment: Which USPS pricing option is requested for rates.
modal: Selects the pricing option USPS returns for rate requests (for example retail versus commercial pricing). Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST.

comment: The USPS account number used with the REST API.
modal: The USPS account number associated with your REST API credentials. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST. Can differ per store view.

comment: The USPS Customer Registration ID (CRID) tied to your account.
modal: Your USPS Customer Registration ID (CRID), identifying your business to USPS. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST.

comment: The USPS Mailer Identifier (MID) associated with your account.
modal: Your USPS Mailer Identifier (MID), used to identify the mailer on shipments. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST.

comment: The Mailer Identifier (MID) used on USPS manifests.
modal: The Manifest MID used when generating USPS manifests. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST.

comment: Whether the carrier connects to the USPS production or test environment.
modal: Switches the carrier between the USPS live/production environment and the development/test environment, which determines which gateway URL is used. Can be set per website.

comment: How items are grouped into packages when USPS rates are requested.
modal: Controls how items are grouped into packages for rate requests (for example a single combined request versus per-package requests). Can be set per website.

comment: The USPS package/container type reported when requesting XML rates.
modal: The packaging/container type reported to USPS when requesting rates, which affects eligible services and prices. Applies only when **USPS Type** is the XML Web Tools. Can be set per website.

comment: The package size category sent to USPS; selecting Large reveals dimension fields.
modal: The USPS package size category. Choosing the **Large** size requires the width, length, height and girth values below. Can be set per website.

comment: The package width used for USPS rating when the size is Large.
modal: The package width sent to USPS for rate calculation. Applies only when **Size** is set to Large. Can be set per website.

comment: The package length used for USPS rating when the size is Large.
modal: The package length sent to USPS for rate calculation. Applies only when **Size** is set to Large. Can be set per website.

comment: The package height used for USPS rating when the size is Large.
modal: The package height sent to USPS for rate calculation. Applies only when **Size** is set to Large. Can be set per website.

comment: The package girth used for USPS rating when the size is Large.
modal: The package girth (the distance around the package) sent to USPS for rate calculation. Applies only when **Size** is set to Large. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether packages are machinable (handled by USPS sorting machines), which affects rates.
modal: Declares whether shipments are machinable — able to be processed by USPS automated sorting equipment — which influences the rates returned. Applies only when **USPS Type** is the XML Web Tools. Can be set per website.

comment: The maximum weight per package before an order is split into multiple packages.
modal: The heaviest a single package may be; orders over this weight are divided into multiple packages for rating. Consult USPS for the maximum supported weight. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether the handling fee is a fixed amount or a percentage of the rate.
modal: Chooses how the handling fee is calculated — as a **fixed** amount or a **percentage** of the shipping rate. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether the handling fee is applied once per order or to each package.
modal: Determines whether the handling fee is charged **per order** or **per package**. Can be set per website.

comment: The handling fee amount or percentage added to USPS rates.
modal: The handling fee value added to the USPS rate, interpreted as a fixed amount or a percentage according to **Calculate Handling Fee**. Can be set per website.

comment: Which USPS (XML Web Tools) shipping methods are offered to customers at checkout.
modal: Selects which USPS services returned by the XML Web Tools API are offered to shoppers at checkout; unselected services are hidden. Applies only when **USPS Type** is the XML Web Tools. Can be set per website.

comment: Which USPS (REST API) shipping methods are offered to customers at checkout.
modal: Selects which USPS services returned by the REST API are offered to shoppers at checkout; unselected services are hidden. Applies only when **USPS Type** is REST. Can be set per website.

comment: Which USPS method is used for orders that qualify for free shipping.
modal: The USPS service used to fulfil orders that qualify for free shipping. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether reaching a minimum order subtotal unlocks free USPS shipping.
modal: Enables or disables a free-shipping threshold for USPS: when set to **Enable**, orders reaching the subtotal set below ship free. Can be set per website.

comment: The order subtotal at which USPS shipping becomes free.
modal: The minimum order subtotal that qualifies for free USPS shipping. Applies only when the free-shipping threshold is enabled. Can be set per website.

comment: The message shown to customers when USPS rates can't be retrieved.
modal: The text shown to shoppers at checkout when the USPS carrier cannot return a rate. Can differ per store view.

comment: Whether USPS is offered to all allowed countries or only selected ones.
modal: Chooses whether USPS shipping is available for **all allowed countries** or only the **specific countries** selected below. Can be set per website.

comment: The countries USPS shipping is offered to when limited to specific countries.
modal: The list of destination countries that may use USPS shipping, applied when **Ship to Applicable Countries** is set to specific countries. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether USPS request and response details are logged for troubleshooting.
modal: When **Yes**, USPS API requests and responses are written to the debug log to help diagnose rating problems. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether USPS is still listed at checkout when it returns no rates.
modal: When **Yes**, the USPS carrier is shown at checkout even when it returns no applicable rates, typically with the error message. Can be set per website.

comment: The position of USPS relative to other carriers in the checkout list.
modal: A numeric value controlling where USPS appears among shipping carriers at checkout; lower values sort higher. Can be set per website.
